limitations: No physical USB/controller flight, other physical PC or real aircraft coefficient calibration in this release.
Actual Chaos fixed-game-time tests are not an independent fixed 120 Hz controller.
Scoring tests cover the implemented FIDA subset; role succession, cards, penalty shootouts, overtime and complete referee workflow remain incomplete.
Competitor simulator references are official-document research, not hands-on product tests.
Portable launcher inspection and bounded headless/offscreen fixtures do not certify an interactive desktop launch on every PC.
